recipe.visualDefinition: A central solarized portrait of a man with an afro, encased in a black-bordered stadium-oval frame, set against a textured halftone background with a top-centered four-line typographic block.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait contained within a geometric capsule frame
High-contrast solarized facial features against vibrant color gradients
Tight, stacked typography balanced against a large central graphic
Uniform halftone dot texture across the entire composition
coreInvariants: Solarized blue-to-white highlight outlines on the face
Warm orange-to-yellow gradient background within the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, high-contrast facial features and the thick black border of the oval frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-centered text, drop down into the oval frame, and follow the solarized outlines of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space on the left and right sides of the central oval, filled with a neutral tan halftone texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue and Maroon (portrait shadows and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange and Yellow (inner frame gradient)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the central oval contrasting with a muted, low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking (touching or near-touching characters)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated, positioned above the main graphic

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family hierarchy using weight or scale variations.
graphicDevices: Stadium-oval frame with thick black stroke

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight 70s spacing style.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp vertices.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1970s album cover background with a tan halftone dot texture. In the center, place a large vertical stadium-oval frame with a thick black border. Inside the oval, generate a solarized portrait of a man with an afro, using high-contrast deep blue and maroon shadows with glowing orange and yellow gradients in the background. The face should have bright blue-white solarized outlines around the eyes, nose, and mouth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of centered text at the top using a geometric sans-serif font like ITC Avant Garde. Set the text in all-caps, black color, with extremely tight tracking so the letters nearly touch. The text should be stacked vertically with tight leading.

verificationChecks: Is the central frame a stadium-oval shape?
Is the portrait solarized with blue/white outlines?
Is the background covered in a consistent halftone dot pattern?
Is the typography centered and tightly kerned?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original catalog numbers in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone texture is visible across the tan background.
Check that the text is perfectly centered above the oval.
Verify the solarized outlines are sharp and high-contrast.
Confirm the oval border is a solid, clean black line.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject] in [Shape] frame + [Solarized] effect + [Halftone] texture + [Geometric Sans] tight-stack typography.
